name: phone-frame
title: Phone Frame
description: iPhone-style device frame with a dynamic island and a screen slot — flat or lightly 3D-tilted, with rise, rotate-in, or float entrances and a subtle float loop.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/phone-frame?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
